canon_ref.note: Three Drake food-industry spies taste-steal the recipe within the hour, echoing the earlier hamburger theft. Ceria confirms the faerie-flower coins are physically indistinguishable from real gold for exactly a day; Erin decides not to exploit it.

b2.erin_invents_pizza_and_faerie_gold_co.summary: Erin invents pizza from memory and watches rival Drake chefs taste-steal the recipe within the hour; with Ceria she also discovers her window-box faerie flowers turn into perfect fake gold for exactly a day, and decides not to exploit it.

canon_ref.note: Erin's [Wondrous Fare] leads her to mix faerie-flower nectar into Halrac's ale; it drops him into a true memory of his destroyed home village and a girl, Ariael, he lost. Erin throws a second drink in his face to snap him out of it.

b2.halrac_drinks_erins_faerie_memory_win.summary: Trying to impress a foul-tempered Halrac, Erin mixes faerie-flower nectar into his ale; it drops him into a vivid true memory of the home and the girl he lost, and she has to shock him out of it before he begs for more.

stage.line: Pawn sits hunched at a corner table long after the last plate is cleared, listening to Erin's stories with a strange new hunger.
stage.note: M8.4: a quiet gathering, not a fight, like the M8.2 concert and M8.3 banquet scenes. Halrac keeps the archer role for the story but has no npc_behaviour entry yet, so he is not walkable.

hooks.news: A second Human sat late into the night at the Wandering Inn as its keeper told old Earth stories to a shaken Antinium individual.

canon_ref.note: Pawn's Queen questioned him and four other individual Antinium about what individuality means; he confesses guilt over Workers who died on his orders. Erin's Moses and Jesus stories calm him and a wary Halrac; his belief triggers the first system-granted [Acolyte] class for an Antinium.

b2.pawns_faith_crisis_earns_the_acolyte_.summary: Distraught after his Queen questions what individuality even means, Pawn confesses his guilt over Workers who died on his orders; Erin's late-night Earth stories calm him and a wary Halrac, and Pawn's real belief earns Liscor's first Antinium [Acolyte] class.

system.name: [Barmaid]
system.note: Levels up despite shirking her firewood errand; level not stated.
